segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the rollout details for the analytics workspace and make sure the quote matches what you need for the April 15 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re still at 42 seats for phase one. That’s 36 standard users and 6 admins. If the operations team joins later, that would be another 18, but not before Q3.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I have 42 seats on the pricing sheet, annual term, billed upfront. The net after the volume discount is $38,640 for the year, plus the one-time onboarding package at $4,800.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had. Can you make sure the invoice breaks out licenses and onboarding separately? Our finance team asked for that so they can code it correctly.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, no problem. I’ll note that in the billing tool and on the order form. For payment terms, we had net 30. Is that still workable?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, net 30 is fine. We just need the invoice dated after April 1, because our purchase order won’t be released until then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I’ll set the contract start date to April 15, invoice date April 2, and service period through April 14 next year. Implementation would start the week of April 8.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. On implementation, we need SSO configured and the first dashboard connected to our warehouse before launch. The rest can come after.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I’ll include SSO and one data connection in the onboarding scope. We’ll schedule two admin training sessions, 60 minutes each, probably April 10 and April 12 if your team is available.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: April 10 is good. April 12 may be tight, but we can confirm by Friday. Send the updated order form and I’ll route it for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the revised order form this afternoon with the seat count, pricing, invoice note, and April dates. If anything changes on the Q3 expansion, we can handle that as an add-on later.
